name: Falcon 9 Block 5 Vehicle
summary: Two-stage, partially reusable medium-lift orbital launch vehicle developed by SpaceX.
function: Delivers payloads and crew to LEO, GTO, and interplanetary trajectories while recovering its first-stage booster propulsively.
materials: Aluminum-lithium (Al-Li 2195) alloy tank walls and domes, carbon-fiber composite interstage, landing legs, and fairing.
history: Evolved from Falcon 9 v1.0 (2010) through v1.1 (2013) and Full Thrust (2015) to Block 5 (first flight May 2018, Bangabandhu-1), engineered for rapid booster reuse with 20+ flights per core.
